description: List/filter issues. status may be comma-separated (e.g. "todo,in_progress"): kinds, or names of the project's own statuses.

assignee.description: a member name or "me" (the caller); also matches text assignees

client.description: issues of this client (its own or its project's): a client name or id

include_subprojects.description: with project: also the issues of all its sub-projects

label.description: only issues with this label, e.g. "bug"

limit.description: at most this many results, e.g. 50

priority.description: urgent, high, medium, low or none

query.description: words to look for in titles and descriptions, e.g. "invoice"

status.description: status kinds or own status names, comma-separated, e.g. "todo,in_progress"

name: list_issues
